app_type: Hybrid Fullstack News Portal & Media Hub
archetype: ARCHETYPE 6: VIBRANT PLAY & ELECTRIC INVESTIGATIVE (Tropical Sunny + Investigative Yellow/Cyan/Deep Blue)

design_philosophy.core_concept: Modern, energetic, eye-catching investigative news portal for Angra dos Reis. Fuses tropical Brazilian coastal vibrant tones (sunburst yellow, ocean cyan, electric magenta accents, deep midnight navy) with a crisp detective magnifying glass branding badge.
anti_patterns_avoided: No boring dull gray news site template
No default Inter typography for headlines (uses Outfit + Plus Jakarta Sans + Space Grotesk accents for JS components)
No flat transparent headers without blur backdrop
No standard square identical grid - uses Tetris Bento grid for news and Instagram/TikTok styled reels player

logo_branding.name: PATY INVESTIGA
logo_branding.icon: Detective Magnifying Glass with glowing lens effect and search pulse ring
logo_branding.badge_style: Vibrant Sun Yellow (#FFC72C) & Electric Teal/Cyan (#00E5FF) with crisp Dark Navy typography, rounded badge container with subtle shadow and magnifying lens overlay on the 'P' or preceding icon
logo_branding.tagline: A verdade por trás dos fatos em Angra dos Reis e Região Costa Verde

heading_rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white leading-tight
heading_rules.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-white

header.style: Sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/85 dark:bg-slate-900/85 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 shadow-sm
elements: Brand Logo (Detective Magnifying Glass + PATY INVESTIGA text)
Navigation Links: início (Home), Notícias, Entrevistas, Vídeos, Reels, Colunas Sociais
Admin Portal quick entrance button with badge indicator

home_bento_grid.mode: MODE A: TETRIS GRID for News Portal

spans.hero_investigation: col-span-full lg:col-span-7 row-span-2 (Main breaking investigation news with big hero image, category pill, author badge, like count, quick share)
spans.featured_video: col-span-full md:col-span-6 lg:col-span-5 (Matéria em vídeo highlight with playable embedded video player)
spans.columnist_spotlight: col-span-full md:col-span-6 lg:col-span-5 (Coluna Social by Paty with avatar, quote snippet, comment counter)
spans.trending_reels: col-span-full row-span-1 (Horizontal scrolling reels tray with play count, vertical video preview, double tap like)

1_home.title: Início - Portal Paty Investiga
1_home.description: Feed principal de notícias com plantão de Angra dos Reis, últimas notícias de política, meio ambiente, turismo, segurança e utilidade pública.

2_entrevistas.title: Entrevistas Exclusivas
2_entrevistas.description: Sessão dedicada a entrevistas em vídeo e áudio/texto com autoridades locais, personalidades de Angra dos Reis, artistas e moradores.

3_materias_video.title: Matérias em Vídeo
3_materias_video.description: Reportagens investigativas completas com players de mídia integrados (suporte a YouTube, Instagram Embed e upload de vídeo direto).

4_reels.title: Vídeos Rápidos (Reels)
4_reels.description: Player estilo TikTok/Instagram Reels na vertical com transição swipe/navegação por setas, curtir instantâneo, comentários em gaveta flutuante e compartilhamento WhatsApp/Redes.

5_colunas_sociais.title: Colunas Sociais
5_colunas_sociais.description: Espaço autoral de Paty cobrindo eventos sociais, festas, bailes, turismo de Angra dos Reis, negócios locais e bastidores da cidade.

6_post_detail.title: Página Detalhada do Post
6_post_detail.description: Exibição completa do artigo/vídeo com leitor de matérias, botão de Like interativo (+1 animação), botão de Compartilhar (copiar link, WhatsApp, Facebook, X), e seção de comentários onde leitores comentam informando APENAS o nome e o comentário.

7_admin_dashboard.title: Painel do Administrador
7_admin_dashboard.description: Área restrita de login para Paty/Admin publicar novas matérias, editar ou excluir posts existentes, gerenciar categorias, adicionar mídias via upload ou links (YouTube/Instagram) e moderar/aprovar comentários dos leitores.

interactive_components.like_button: Heart animation with confetti scale state, instant persistent counter update
interactive_components.share_modal: Popover with 1-click WhatsApp share link, Direct URL copy, and social network buttons
interactive_components.comments_section: Name-only input form (sem necessidade de e-mail/senha) + text area, real-time submission with instantly updating comment stream
interactive_components.reels_viewer: Vertical snap scrolling with side action bar (Heart like, Comment drawer button, Share, Sound toggle)
interactive_components.admin_manager: Post creation modal with title, slug, category select, type select (Notícia, Entrevistas, Vídeo, Reels, Coluna Social), image URL/upload, video YouTube embed link, rich text body editor, and published status switch.

testing_guidelines.data_testid_convention: kebab-case mandatory attributes on all interactive elements

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the code is clean JavaScript React (.js files).
Make sure the UI is completely in Portuguese as requested by the user.
Logo MUST incorporate a prominent detective magnifying glass with vibrant yellow/cyan accents and 'PATY INVESTIGA' wording.
Implement real mock initial posts for Angra dos Reis covering News, Interviews, Video stories, Social Columns, and Reels.
Ensure readers can comment by typing ONLY their name and comment text (no mandatory email/password sign-up for readers).
Admin section must allow login (e.g., admin / admin123 or configurable) to add, edit, delete posts, and manage media upload links.
